disposition: DISCLOSED_LIMITATION: collapse stutter and transient simulation slowdown remain. 240 ms was discarded over about 14 s; collapse-window time deficit about 4.4%; worst approximately one second about 20.7%. inheritedMechanism: main animation loop clamps each visible frame to 60 ms with no catch-up; the UI FPS counter uses that clamped duration and can overstate presentation FPS. Loop is byte-identical to current main.
